name: VillageRide
description: Uber/DiDi-style ride-hailing + goods delivery marketplace for village taxi associations.
purpose: Give village taxi associations a ride-hailing platform, expanded into an Amazon-style goods delivery marketplace built on the same ride infrastructure.
notes: Live GPS/ETA tracking, Google Maps driver navigation, and a full goods delivery marketplace (vendors/products/cart/checkout/dispatch/tracking) reusing the ride-hailing infrastructure. Vendors are Super Admin-onboarded only (no self-service yet); production had zero real vendors as of last check. Just launched a zero-commission promo on the landing page.

name: Tax
description: AI-powered Australian individual tax return platform, plus an accountant portal for managing multiple clients' returns.
purpose: Reduce a 2-hour Australian tax return into a 5-minute AI conversation, for employees, sole-traders, and gig workers.
aiFeatures: AI-powered per-deduction risk review against real ATO thresholds
AI bank/share transaction categorisation and CGT extraction
notes: Full Australian individual tax return flow (deductions, CGT/dividends, refund optimiser, AI risk reviewer, review/lodgment) verified to the cent against Dhanu's own real ATO return, plus an accountant portal v1 for directly managing multiple clients' returns.

name: NEXORA Finance OS
description: AI-first finance/ERP platform — double-entry ledger, multi-entity consolidation, AP/AR, banking, procurement, and three AI personas.
purpose: Build a modern AI-native finance/ERP platform aiming to beat SAP/Oracle/NetSuite/Xero/QuickBooks on intelligence, usability, implementation speed, and TCO.
aiFeatures: AI Accountant — drafts balanced journal entries from plain-language descriptions, human-approved before posting
AI Controller — anomaly-detection review gating period close
AI CFO — board narrative grounded in real P&L/balance sheet data, advisory only
notes: Multi-entity double-entry ledger with full AP/AR, bank reconciliation, purchase orders (PO-to-bill splitting), multi-entity consolidation (intercompany eliminations + FX translation), and all three PRD AI personas — 22 sessions in. Payroll, a tax engine, and live bank-feed sync are deliberately deferred pending real PII/compliance scoping and Plaid credentials.
